envelope.author: nico
envelope.reason: operator steer: badge on the claude status line

payload.gloss: the running persona's name and mark emoji shown in the harness status line so the operator sees which persona a session runs; projected from the agent cell into that persona's own launch scope, so placement names the persona and nothing asks at runtime; shown only in the top-level interactive session, never a subagent's; its own module, apart from guardrails and session hooks; carries no hue where the harness strips color (omp strips it from extension status text) On Claude Code the status line is one host-owned command with no segments: install sets a badge status line only where the host has none, and otherwise offers to wrap the host's command, never replacing it.
